The house ritual

Fire up the wok

Order here and you get asked three things: what, with what, and how hot. This kitchen means the last one — they count 0 to 5.

Sumalee’s

The story

The chef it’s named for

Sumalee’s is exactly what the sign says — one chef’s small, family-owned kitchen. Chef Sumalee grew up cooking in Southern Thailand, and you can taste it in the curries.

Sixty-seven dishes on the board, and every one of them goes in the wok when you ask for it. Gluten-free on most of the menu, and the kitchen happily cooks around an allergy — say the word when you order.

The room is warm and easy: salmon walls, a slate fireplace, art on every side, and a counter you can wait at while they cook.
